slots.title: Market sideways kyun ghoomta hai, aur phir achanak trend kyun pakad le

post.cap:
Market sideways kyun ghoomta hai, aur phir achanak trend kyun pakad leta hai? 📊

Market ki sirf 2 haalat hoti hain: Balance aur Imbalance. Balance me buyers aur sellers ek bhaav pe raazi hain, price daayre me ghoomta hai. Imbalance me ek taraf jaldi me hai, purana bhaav unfair ho gaya, aur price naya balance dhoondhne nikal padta hai.
